_note: ad-watch output: a DECOMPOSITION of a real ad, NOT a production. `coordinate` is INFERRED and partial (we are guessing the advertiser's targeting from the outside, so leave a field empty rather than invent). Each beat carries BOTH a structured `visual` slot object (the source of truth for the diegetic variables; the set of keys IS the vehicle's template) AND a `t2i`/`i2v` reconstruction (so produce can regenerate a lookalike today without a slot-to-prompt renderer). DECIDE THE COPY SOURCE per ad (do not assume VO): set `coordinate.copy_source` to vo | captions | both | none. `vo` holds the REAL spoken line ONLY when the ad actually speaks; `visual.on_screen_text` holds burned-in captions (often the real script in UGC/social ads). `duration` is the REAL measured seconds. `role` is a best-effort arc mapping (hook/symptom/solution/result/cta); use shot-1, shot-2 if the ad does not map to our arc. IMAGES: one beat per image, `vo` null, copy in `visual.on_screen_text`, `duration` null.

coordinate.concept: <vehicle read off the ad: char-3p-drama | text-on-gameplay | short-drama | ugc | app-demo | kinetic-text>
coordinate.length: <micro | short | mid | long, derived from the measured total duration>
coordinate.treatment: <look read off the ad: live-action | claymation | photoreal | 2D | mixed>
coordinate.voice: <gender + quality read off the VO, or empty if no VO>
coordinate.music: <one-line description of the track, or empty>
coordinate.copy_source: <how the ad delivers its message, DECIDED from the evidence: vo | captions | both | none>

beats.t2i: <reconstruction film-still prompt: what you would write to regenerate this shot>
beats.i2v: <reconstruction motion prompt, or empty for an image>
beats.vo: <the real transcribed line covering this beat's time range>
